setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(99)
n = 1000
k = rng.integers(0, 2, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 8, (2, 20))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 20)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(20)])
df['label'] = [f'cls_{v}' for v in k]

steps.name: compute screen coordinates of an anchor point for drawing
steps.eval: const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const sc = a.renderer.projectWorld(a.anchorXY[0], a.anchorXY[1]); window.__sx0 = Math.round(r.left + (sc ? sc[0] : r.width * 0.4)); window.__sy0 = Math.round(r.top + (sc ? sc[1] : r.height * 0.4));

steps.name: draw a rectangle by dragging over data
steps.drag: (() => { const x0 = window.__sx0 - 60; const y0 = window.__sy0 - 50; return [[x0, y0], [x0+120, y0+100]]; })()

steps.name: move the rectangle by patching x,y
steps.eval: const rect = a.shapes.find(s => s.kind === 'rect'); if (rect) { window.__rectId = rect.id; const delta = a.renderer.worldPerPixel() * 5; a.updateShape(rect.id, { x: rect.x + delta, y: rect.y + delta }); }

steps.name: check pixels at projected rect position after pan and rotation
steps.eval: const rect = a.shapes[0]; const wx = rect.x + rect.w / 2; const wy = rect.y + rect.h / 2; const sc = a.renderer.projectWorld(wx, wy); window.__rectScreenPos = sc;

steps.name: tag points inside rectangle shape
steps.eval: const rect = a.shapes.find(s => s.kind === 'rect'); if (rect) a.tagPointsInShape(rect.id, 'shape_col')

steps.name: shapes JSON export and re-import
steps.eval: const json = a.exportShapes(); const nBefore = a.shapes.length; a.shapes = []; a.renderer.setShapes([]); a.importShapes(json);

steps.name: shapes present in PNG export
steps.eval: const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.width; c.height = img.height; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = g.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let nBright = 0; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) if (d[i] + d[i+1] + d[i+2] > 60) nBright++; window.__shapePixels = nBright
